categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: Industrial Internet and Mobile Internet. The Industrial Internet segment focuses on intelligent bulk material conveyor systems, including conveyor belt manufacturing, intelligent conveyor system products, and integrated digital solutions for industries such as mining, steel, ports, and building materials. The Mobile Internet segment centers on global mobile game development, publishing, and operation, targeting overseas markets with a portfolio of diverse game genres and IP collaborations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including AI, IoT, big data, cloud computing, and industrial automation to develop intelligent conveyor belts and systems. It employs customized production methods for conveyor belts, integrating green materials and digital lifecycle management. In gaming, it uses full-stack AI technology for AIGC lifecycle management, enhancing game development, localization, marketing, and user engagement. The company also invests in R&D for bio-based materials, intelligent robotics, and smart sensors.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global mining giants (e.g., BHP, Rio Tinto), major steel producers (e.g., Baowu Steel, Tata Steel), large building materials companies (e.g., CNBM, Lafarge), bulk cargo ports, and power generation enterprises. The mobile internet business serves global gamers across mature markets like Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, Europe, and the Americas, as well as emerging markets. The company maintains deep partnerships with international strategic clients and gaming developers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a strong domestic base in China with expanding global operations. It has established manufacturing and service centers in Thailand and Australia, and a global technology service network covering five continents. Its mobile gaming business operates in over 150 countries and regions, with key markets in Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, Europe, and the Americas. It also actively explores emerging markets such as South America and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. In industrial internet, it manufactures conveyor belts and provides integrated intelligent conveyor system solutions and services. In mobile internet, it acts as a game developer, publisher, and operator, managing game lifecycle and distribution channels. It also engages in upstream R&D for materials and technologies but mainly focuses on product manufacturing and service delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing the 'New Four Modernizations' focusing on green, intelligent, integrated, and global development. R&D emphasizes bio-based materials, embodied intelligent robots, smart sensors, and low-carbon manufacturing. The company integrates AI deeply into industrial and gaming operations, developing AI-powered inspection robots and AIGC platforms for game lifecycle management. It pursues open technology alliances, intellectual property expansion, and sustainable ESG practices, aiming to lead industry innovation and global market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through direct product sales of conveyor belts and intelligent conveyor systems, integrated service contracts, and digital solutions in the industrial internet segment. The mobile internet segment earns revenue primarily from game publishing and operation, including in-app purchases and licensing fees, mainly from overseas markets via platforms like AppStore and GooglePlay. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income, with a mix of direct sales, licensing, and service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a pioneer and leader in intelligent bulk material conveyor solutions and a leading Chinese mobile game publisher overseas. It competes with other industrial conveyor manufacturers and digital solution providers, leveraging its technological innovation and global service network. In gaming, it is among the top Chinese mobile game exporters with strong market shares in key overseas regions. Its competitive edge lies in integrated intelligent solutions, AI application, and global strategic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 3.3 billion, a 9.67% decrease from 2023, but net profit attributable to shareholders nearly doubled with a 97.93% increase to RMB 210 million. The industrial internet segment accounted for 56.5% of revenue, while mobile gaming contributed 43.5%. The company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 6.1 billion and continues investing in R&D with expenditures around RMB 141 million. Despite revenue decline, profitability and global expansion show strong growth momentum.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes 'safe, efficient, and green' intelligent conveyor solutions that integrate advanced AI and digital technologies to enhance operational safety, efficiency, and sustainability for industrial clients. Its gaming products offer high-quality, culturally rich, and globally localized digital entertainment experiences, supported by AI-driven development and user engagement platforms. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive full-stack services, global technical support, innovative R&D, and a strong commitment to ESG principles, delivering unique value to customers worldwide.
